title: Abba bar Acha bar Salla of Kafri
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is the father of Rabbi Chiyya, of Aivu the father of Rav, of Chana the father of Rabbah, of Shila and of Marta. He is mentioned in [Sanhedrin 5a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.5a.12) concerning the lineage of his sons and family.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked text names Abba bar Acha Karsalla of Kafri. Hyman’s heading reads bar Salla.
The Bavli lists the five sons and distinguishes Rav’s relationship to Rabbi Chiyya from that of Rabba bar Chana.
